title: FedMark: Large-Capacity and Robust Watermarking in Federated Learning
motivation: Real-world FL systems involve many participants (>50), yet existing watermarking only supports <40 owners
problem_framing: Watermark capacity = max watermarks where accuracy degradation <1% and detection rate >95%
key_insight: Bloom Filter with N hash functions reduces per-watermark constraints from T to N (N<<T), enabling 150+ participants
method_signature: Bloom Filter watermarking + secret sharing verification in horizontal FL
evaluation_criteria: Watermark capacity (>150), accuracy impact (<1%), detection rate (>95%), robustness to attacks
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Proposed mechanism not suitable for vertical FL; assumes semi-honest participants but malicious participants could infer watermark info
evidence_for_taste: M should be set to a sufficient length
thinking_moves: 先证存在性( Lemma 1, Theorem 1), 再识别实践瓶颈
把容量问题分解为有限参数 vs 标记冲突两个约束
用 Bloom Filter 的空间效率换取约束数量的降低
引入密码学原语(秘密共享)解决概率数据结构的假阳性问题
